title.sk: Praženica s paradajkami a bryndzou
title.en: Scrambled eggs with tomatoes and bryndza

description.sk: Krémové vajíčka s dusenými paradajkami a slanou bryndzou na chlebe.
description.en: Creamy eggs with softened tomatoes and salty bryndza on bread.

steps.sk: Paradajky umy, rozkroj na štvrtiny, vyrež tvrdý stred so stopkou a dužinu nakrájaj na kocky asi 1 cm. Jarnú cibuľku nakrájaj na tenké kolieska a zelenú časť odlož bokom – biela pôjde do panvice, zelená navrch.
steps.en: Wash the tomatoes, quarter them, cut out the hard core and dice the flesh into roughly 1 cm cubes. Thinly slice the spring onions and keep the green tops apart: the white goes into the pan, the green on top.

steps.sk: Vajcia rozbi do misky, pridaj štipku soli a korenie a vidličkou ich dôkladne rozšľahaj. Soli daj naozaj len štipku – bryndza, ktorú pridáš na konci, je výrazne slaná a praženicu dosolí sama.
steps.en: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add a pinch of salt and the pepper and beat thoroughly with a fork. Really use only a pinch of salt: the bryndza added at the end is very salty and seasons the eggs by itself.

steps.sk: Na nepriľnavej panvici rozpusti maslo na strednom ohni, pridaj bielu časť cibuľky a 1 minútu ju opekaj. Pridaj paradajky a nechaj ich 3 minúty dusiť, kým nepustia šťavu a tá sa sčasti neodparí – inak by bola praženica vodnatá.
steps.en: Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over a medium heat, add the white spring onion and fry for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes until they release their juice and it partly evaporates, otherwise the eggs turn watery.

steps.sk: Zníž oheň na mierny, vlej vajcia a chvíľu ich nechaj, kým okraje nezačnú tuhnúť. Potom ich stierkou pomaly posúvaj od okraja k stredu, aby vznikali veľké mäkké vločky; celé to trvá asi 3 minúty.
steps.en: Turn the heat down to low, pour in the eggs and leave them for a moment until the edges begin to set. Then slowly push them from the edge to the centre with a spatula to form large soft curds; it takes about 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Keď sú vajcia takmer stuhnuté, ale ešte lesklé, rozdrob na ne bryndzu a stiahni panvicu z ohňa. Premiešaj iba raz či dvakrát, aby sa bryndza zohriala a jemne roztopila, no nezmenila sa na kašu.
steps.en: When the eggs are almost set but still glossy, crumble the bryndza over them and take the pan off the heat. Stir only once or twice so the bryndza warms and softens slightly without turning to mush.

steps.sk: Praženicu rozdeľ na krajce chleba, posyp zelenou cibuľkou a čerstvo mletým korením. Podávaj hneď – postátím by vajcia dotuhli a stratili krémovosť.
steps.en: Spoon the eggs onto the slices of bread and sprinkle with the green spring onion and freshly ground pepper. Serve at once: left to stand, the eggs firm up and lose their creaminess.

title.sk: Pohánková kaša s jablkom a vlašskými orechmi
title.en: Buckwheat porridge with apple and walnuts

description.sk: Teplá mliečna kaša z pohánky, ktorá zasýti na celé dopoludnie.
description.en: A warm milky buckwheat porridge that keeps you full all morning.

steps.sk: Pohánku nasyp do jemného sitka a prepláchni ju pod studenou tečúcou vodou, kým nestečie číra – zmyje sa prach aj horkastá pachuť. Nechaj ju chvíľu odkvapkať, kým pripravíš jablko.
steps.en: Tip the buckwheat into a fine sieve and rinse it under cold running water until it runs clear; this washes off the dust and any bitter taste. Leave it to drain while you prepare the apple.

steps.sk: Jablko umy, rozštvrť, vykroj jadrovník a nakrájaj ho na kocky asi 1 cm; šupku nechaj, kaša bude mať viac vlákniny. Orechy opraž 3 minúty nasucho na panvici, kým nezavoňajú, a nahrubo ich nalámaj.
steps.en: Wash the apple, quarter it, cut out the core and dice it into roughly 1 cm cubes; leave the skin on for more fibre. Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes until fragrant, then break them up roughly.

steps.sk: Do hrnca daj pohánku, 250 ml mlieka, 100 ml vody, štipku soli a polovicu jablka. Priveď do varu, zníž oheň na minimum a pod pokrievkou var 15 minút; občas premiešaj, aby sa mlieko nepripálilo na dno.
steps.en: Put the buckwheat in a pan with 250 ml of the milk, 100 ml of water, a pinch of salt and half the apple. Bring to the boil, turn the heat right down and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes, stirring now and then so the milk does not catch.

steps.sk: Pohánka je hotová, keď je mäkká, ale zrnká zostali celé a tekutina sa takmer vpila. Primiešaj zvyšné mlieko, škoricu a med; ak je kaša príliš hustá, prilej ešte trochu mlieka alebo vody.
steps.en: The buckwheat is done when tender but the grains are still whole and the liquid is almost absorbed. Stir in the remaining milk, the cinnamon and the honey; if the porridge is too thick, add a little more milk or water.

steps.sk: Rozdeľ ju do misiek, navrch daj zvyšné kocky jablka, orechy a podľa chuti kúsok masla. Kaša vydrží v chladničke 3 dni; pred jedením ju zohrej s lyžicou mlieka, lebo v chlade zhustne.
steps.en: Divide it between bowls and top with the rest of the apple, the walnuts and, if you like, a knob of butter. The porridge keeps in the fridge for 3 days; reheat it with a spoonful of milk, as it thickens when cold.

title.sk: Pšenová kaša s malinami a medom
title.en: Millet porridge with raspberries and honey

description.sk: Babičkina pšenová kaša, krémová a s ovocnou kyslosťou malín.
description.en: Grandma's creamy millet porridge, brightened by tart raspberries.

steps.sk: Pšeno nasyp do sitka, prelej ho horúcou vodou z kanvice a potom ho prepláchni studenou. Horúca voda zmyje horkastý povlak na zrnkách, pre ktorý majú niektorí ľudia pšeno neradi.
steps.en: Put the millet in a sieve, pour boiling water from the kettle over it, then rinse it under cold water. The hot water washes off the bitter coating on the grains that puts some people off millet.

steps.sk: Do hrnca nalej 350 ml mlieka, pridaj štipku soli a priveď ho do varu – stráž ho, mlieko rado vykypí. Vsyp pšeno, premiešaj, zníž oheň na minimum a var prikryté 20 minút, kým zrnká nezmäknú a nevpijú mlieko.
steps.en: Pour 350 ml of the milk into a pan, add a pinch of salt and bring it to the boil, watching it, as milk boils over easily. Add the millet, stir, turn the heat right down and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes until the grains are soft and have absorbed the milk.

steps.sk: Medzitým roztlač vidličkou polovicu malín s 1 lyžicou medu na hrubé pyré; zvyšné maliny nechaj celé na ozdobu. Mrazené maliny stačí nechať pri izbovej teplote rozmrznúť, kým sa varí kaša.
steps.en: Meanwhile mash half the raspberries with 1 tablespoon of the honey into a rough purée with a fork; keep the rest whole for the top. Frozen raspberries just need to thaw at room temperature while the porridge cooks.

steps.sk: Hotovú kašu stiahni z ohňa a vmiešaj do nej maslo, vanilkový cukor a zvyšné mlieko, aby bola krémová. Nechaj ju 5 minút postáť pod pokrievkou – dotiahne sa a ešte trochu zhustne.
steps.en: Take the cooked porridge off the heat and stir in the butter, vanilla sugar and the remaining milk to make it creamy. Leave it to stand, covered, for 5 minutes; it settles and thickens a little more.

steps.sk: Kašu rozdeľ do misiek, do stredu daj malinové pyré, navrch celé maliny a pokvapkaj ju zvyšným medom. Podávaj teplú; vychladnutá pšenová kaša stuhne, preto ju pri zohrievaní rozrieď trochou mlieka.
steps.en: Divide the porridge between bowls, spoon the raspberry purée into the middle, top with the whole raspberries and drizzle with the rest of the honey. Serve warm; cold millet porridge sets firm, so loosen it with a little milk when reheating.

title.sk: Tvarohové lievanečky s čučoriedkami
title.en: Quark pancakes with blueberries

description.sk: Nadýchané malé placky z tvarohu, v ktorých praskajú čučoriedky.
description.en: Fluffy little quark pancakes studded with bursting blueberries.

steps.sk: V miske rozmiešaj tvaroh s vajcami, cukrom, vanilkovým cukrom a štipkou soli metlou do hladka – hrudky tvarohu by v lievanečkoch zostali. Ak je tvaroh veľmi suchý a drobivý, pridaj lyžicu mlieka.
steps.en: In a bowl, whisk the quark with the eggs, sugar, vanilla sugar and a pinch of salt until smooth; lumps of quark would stay in the pancakes. If the quark is very dry and crumbly, add a spoonful of milk.

steps.sk: Múku zmiešaj s práškom do pečiva a stierkou ju vmiešaj do tvarohovej zmesi len dovtedy, kým nezmiznú suché miesta. Cesto má byť husté ako hustá kyslá smotana a ťahať sa z lyžice; nechaj ho 5 minút odpočinúť.
steps.en: Mix the flour with the baking powder and fold it into the quark mixture with a spatula just until no dry patches remain. The batter should be as thick as thick sour cream and fall from the spoon in a ribbon; let it rest for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Nepriľnavú panvicu zohrej na strednom ohni a potri ju tenkou vrstvou oleja. Lyžicou na ňu nakladaj kôpky cesta s priemerom asi 8 cm a do každej hneď zatlač 5 až 6 čučoriedok; nechaj medzi nimi miesto, cesto sa trochu roztečie.
steps.en: Heat a non-stick pan over a medium heat and brush it with a thin layer of oil. Spoon in mounds of batter about 8 cm across and press 5 or 6 blueberries into each straight away; leave space between them, as the batter spreads a little.

steps.sk: Peč 2 až 3 minúty, kým sa spodok nezazlatí a okraje nezmatnejú, potom lievanečky opatrne obráť a peč ešte 2 minúty. Na príliš vysokom ohni zhnednú zvonka, ale vnútri zostanú surové, preto radšej pomalšie.
steps.en: Cook for 2 to 3 minutes until golden underneath and matt at the edges, then carefully flip them and cook for 2 minutes more. Over too high a heat they brown outside but stay raw inside, so take it slowly.

steps.sk: Hotové lievanečky ukladaj na tanier do teplej rúry (80 °C), kým upečieš zvyšok; pred každou dávkou panvicu znova potri olejom. Podávaj s kyslou smotanou alebo medom a so zvyšnými čučoriedkami.
steps.en: Keep the cooked pancakes warm on a plate in a low oven (80 °C) while you cook the rest, brushing the pan with oil before each batch. Serve with sour cream or honey and the remaining blueberries.

title.sk: Skyr s chia, ovsom a lesným ovocím
title.en: Skyr with chia, oats and berries

description.sk: Raňajky bez varenia s poriadnou dávkou bielkovín.
description.en: A no-cook breakfast with a proper helping of protein.

steps.sk: Lesné ovocie nasyp do misky a nechaj ho 10 minút rozmrznúť pri izbovej teplote; pri rozmrazovaní pustí šťavu, ktorá misku prirodzene osladí a zafarbí. Čerstvé ovocie stačí opláchnuť a osušiť.
steps.en: Tip the berries into a bowl and leave them to thaw at room temperature for 10 minutes; as they thaw they release juice that naturally sweetens and colours the bowl. Fresh berries only need a rinse and a pat dry.

steps.sk: Mandle nasekaj nožom na kúsky veľké asi ako zrnko ryže – celé by boli v miske príliš tvrdé. Ak chceš výraznejšiu chuť, opraž ich 2 minúty nasucho na panvici a nechaj ich vychladnúť.
steps.en: Chop the almonds with a knife into pieces about the size of a grain of rice; whole ones would be too hard in the bowl. For a deeper flavour, toast them in a dry pan for 2 minutes and let them cool.

steps.sk: Skyr vyklop do misky a vmiešaj do neho chia semienka, ovsené vločky a med. Nechaj ho 5 minút stáť – chia aj vločky natiahnu trochu tekutiny, zmes zhustne a semienka zmäknú.
steps.en: Turn the skyr into a bowl and stir in the chia seeds, oats and honey. Let it stand for 5 minutes; the chia and oats absorb some of the liquid, the mixture thickens and the seeds soften.

steps.sk: Navrch rozlož ovocie aj so šťavou a posyp ho mandľami. Ak misku chystáš večer na ráno, ovocie a mandle pridaj až pred jedením, aby mandle zostali chrumkavé; v chladničke vydrží do druhého dňa.
steps.en: Spoon the berries and their juice over the top and scatter with the almonds. If you make it the evening before, add the fruit and almonds just before eating so the almonds stay crunchy; it keeps in the fridge until the next day.

title.sk: Domáca granola s orechmi a medom
title.en: Homemade granola with nuts and honey

description.sk: Chrumkavé zhluky vločiek a orechov – jeden plech vystačí na týždne.
description.en: Crunchy clusters of oats and nuts; one tray lasts for weeks.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 160 °C (horný a spodný ohrev) a plech vystel papierom na pečenie. Nižšia teplota je dôležitá – pri vyššej by med rýchlo pripálil a granola by zhorkla skôr, ako stihne vyschnúť.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 160 °C (top and bottom heat) and line a baking tray with baking paper. The low temperature matters: at a higher one the honey scorches quickly and the granola turns bitter before it has dried out.

steps.sk: Orechy a mandle nahrubo nasekaj a vo veľkej miske ich zmiešaj s ovsenými vločkami, slnečnicovými semienkami, škoricou a štipkou soli. Hrozienka zatiaľ odlož – v rúre by stvrdli a pripálili sa.
steps.en: Roughly chop the walnuts and almonds and mix them in a large bowl with the oats, sunflower seeds, cinnamon and a pinch of salt. Set the raisins aside for now; in the oven they would harden and burn.

steps.sk: Med s olejom zohrej v malom hrnci alebo v mikrovlnke len toľko, aby bol tekutý, a vylej ho na suchú zmes. Premiešaj ju rukami alebo stierkou, kým nie sú všetky vločky rovnomerne lesklé a vlhké.
steps.en: Warm the honey and oil in a small pan or the microwave just until runny and pour it over the dry mixture. Mix with your hands or a spatula until every flake is evenly glossy and moist.

steps.sk: Zmes rozotri na plech v tenkej vrstve a jemne ju pritlač, aby vznikli zhluky. Peč 25 minút; v polovici času ju raz opatrne premiešaj a otoč plech, aby sa okraje nepripálili. Hotová je zlatistá a vonia.
steps.en: Spread the mixture thinly on the tray and press it down lightly so clusters form. Bake for 25 minutes, stirring gently once halfway and turning the tray so the edges do not burn. It is done when golden and fragrant.

steps.sk: Granolu nechaj na plechu úplne vychladnúť bez miešania – chrumkavou sa stane až pri chladnutí. Potom ju nalámaj, primiešaj hrozienka a skladuj v uzavretom pohári až 3 týždne. Podávaj s jogurtom alebo mliekom.
steps.en: Let the granola cool completely on the tray without stirring; it only turns crunchy as it cools. Then break it up, mix in the raisins and store it in an airtight jar for up to 3 weeks. Serve with yogurt or milk.

title.sk: Anglické raňajky na jednej panvici
title.en: One-pan full English breakfast

description.sk: Klobása, slanina, vajce, huby a fazuľa v paradajkovej omáčke – výdatný víkendový štart.
description.en: Sausage, bacon, egg, mushrooms and beans in tomato sauce: a hearty weekend start.

steps.sk: Klobásu nakrájaj šikmo na plátky hrubé asi 1 cm, šampiňóny na štvrtiny a paradajky rozpoľ. Fazuľu sceď, prepláchni a v malom hrnci ju zmiešaj s passatou, cukrom, štipkou soli a 3 lyžicami vody.
steps.en: Slice the sausage diagonally about 1 cm thick, quarter the mushrooms and halve the tomatoes. Drain and rinse the beans and mix them in a small pan with the passata, sugar, a pinch of salt and 3 tablespoons of water.

steps.sk: Hrniec s fazuľou daj na mierny oheň a nechaj ju 10 minút pomaly prebublávať, kým omáčka nezhustne a fazuľa nezmäkne. Občas premiešaj; ak omáčka príliš zhustne, prilej lyžicu vody.
steps.en: Set the beans over a low heat and let them bubble gently for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens and the beans soften. Stir now and then, adding a spoonful of water if it gets too thick.

steps.sk: Na veľkú panvicu daj slaninu a klobásu bez oleja a na strednom ohni ich opekaj 5 až 6 minút, kým slanina nie je chrumkavá a klobása dozlatista. Prelož ich na okraj panvice alebo na tanier do teplej rúry.
steps.en: Put the bacon and sausage in a large frying pan without oil and fry over a medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes until the bacon is crisp and the sausage golden. Push them to the edge of the pan or keep them warm on a plate in a low oven.

steps.sk: Vo vypečenom tuku opekaj šampiňóny 4 minúty, kým nezhnednú, a paradajky položené reznou stranou nadol 3 minúty. Šampiňóny pri opekaní nesoľ – pustili by šťavu a dusili by sa namiesto toho, aby zhnedli.
steps.en: In the rendered fat, fry the mushrooms for 4 minutes until browned and the tomatoes cut side down for 3 minutes. Do not salt the mushrooms while frying; they would release liquid and stew instead of browning.

steps.sk: Na uvoľnené miesto nalej olej, rozbi naň vajcia a opekaj ich na miernom ohni 3 minúty, kým bielok úplne nestuhne a žĺtok zostane tekutý. Medzitým opeč toastový chlieb.
steps.en: Add the oil to the free space, crack in the eggs and fry them over a low heat for 3 minutes until the whites are fully set and the yolks still runny. Toast the bread meanwhile.

steps.sk: Na taniere rozdeľ toast, fazuľu, klobásu, slaninu, šampiňóny, paradajky a vajce a okoreň. Podávaj hneď, kým je všetko horúce – sú to výdatné raňajky, ktoré zasýtia až do obeda.
steps.en: Share out the toast, beans, sausage, bacon, mushrooms, tomatoes and eggs between plates and season with pepper. Serve at once while everything is hot; it is a hearty breakfast that keeps you going until lunch.

title.sk: Huevos rancheros – vajcia v paradajkovej salse s tortillou
title.en: Huevos rancheros: eggs in tomato salsa on tortillas

description.sk: Vajcia uvarené priamo v pikantnej salse, podávané na opečených tortillách.
description.en: Eggs cooked right in a spicy salsa and served on toasted tortillas.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na drobné kocky, cesnak na tenké plátky a čili papričku pozdĺžne rozkroj, vyškrab semienka a nasekaj ju nadrobno. Semienka nechaj, iba ak máš rád naozaj ostré jedlo; po krájaní si umy ruky.
steps.en: Finely dice the onion, thinly slice the garlic, split the chili lengthways, scrape out the seeds and chop it finely. Keep the seeds only if you like it really hot, and wash your hands after cutting it.

steps.sk: V hlbšej panvici zohrej olej na strednom ohni a opekaj cibuľu 5 minút, kým nezmäkne a nezosklovatie. Pridaj cesnak, čili a rascu (kmín) a miešaj ešte 1 minútu, kým korenie nezavonia.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over a medium heat and fry the onion for 5 minutes until soft and translucent. Add the garlic, chili and cumin and stir for 1 minute more until the spices are fragrant.

steps.sk: Vlej paradajky z konzervy, osoľ a nechaj salsu bez pokrievky 10 minút prebublávať, kým nezhustne natoľko, že po prejdení lyžicou zostane na dne chvíľu stopa. Príliš riedka salsa by vajcia rozliala.
steps.en: Pour in the canned tomatoes, season with the salt and let the salsa bubble uncovered for 10 minutes until it is thick enough that a spoon dragged across the bottom leaves a brief trail. Too runny a salsa would let the eggs spread.

steps.sk: Lyžicou urob v salse 4 jamky, do každej rozbi vajce a panvicu prikry. Var na miernom ohni 5 až 7 minút, kým bielky celkom nestuhnú a žĺtky sú ešte mäkké; ak chceš tvrdšie, nechaj ich o 2 minúty dlhšie.
steps.en: Make 4 hollows in the salsa with a spoon, crack an egg into each and cover the pan. Cook over a low heat for 5 to 7 minutes until the whites are completely set and the yolks still soft; leave them 2 minutes longer if you prefer them firm.

steps.sk: Medzitým opeč tortilly na suchej panvici alebo priamo nad plynom asi 30 sekúnd z každej strany, kým nie sú pružné a miestami opálené. Avokádo nakrájaj na plátky a limetku na mesiačiky.
steps.en: Meanwhile toast the tortillas in a dry pan or directly over a gas flame for about 30 seconds a side until pliable and charred in places. Slice the avocado and cut the lime into wedges.

steps.sk: Na každý tanier polož dve tortilly, navrch preložia dve vajcia so salsou, avokádo a posyp ich koriandrom. Podávaj hneď s limetkou – štipľavosť salsy zjemní kyslá šťava aj avokádo.
steps.en: Lay two tortillas on each plate and top with two eggs and their salsa, the avocado and a sprinkling of coriander. Serve at once with the lime; its sharp juice and the avocado soften the heat of the salsa.

title.sk: Raňajkové burrito s vajcom, fazuľou a syrom
title.en: Breakfast burrito with egg, beans and cheese

description.sk: Zabalené raňajky do ruky, ktoré sa dajú pripraviť do zásoby a zamraziť.
description.en: A breakfast to eat in your hand that can be made ahead and frozen.

steps.sk: Papriku zbav semienok a nakrájaj na drobné kocky, jarnú cibuľku na tenké kolieska a čedar nastrúhaj nahrubo. Fazuľu sceď, prepláchni a nechaj odkvapkať, aby burrito nebolo mokré.
steps.en: Seed the pepper and dice it finely, thinly slice the spring onions and coarsely grate the cheddar. Drain and rinse the beans and let them drip so the burrito is not soggy.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozpusti polovicu masla a opekaj papriku 3 minúty, kým nezmäkne. Pridaj fazuľu, rascu a 2 lyžice vody a za stáleho miešania ju 2 minúty zohrievaj; vidličkou asi tretinu fazule roztlač, aby plnka držala pokope.
steps.en: Melt half the butter in a frying pan and fry the pepper for 3 minutes until soft. Add the beans, cumin and 2 tablespoons of water and heat for 2 minutes, stirring; mash about a third of the beans with a fork so the filling holds together.

steps.sk: Fazuľu prelož do misky, panvicu vytri a rozpusti v nej zvyšné maslo na miernom ohni. Vajcia rozšľahaj so soľou a korením, vlej ich na panvicu a stierkou ich posúvaj, kým nevzniknú mäkké vločky, ešte trochu vlhké.
steps.en: Tip the beans into a bowl, wipe the pan and melt the rest of the butter in it over a low heat. Beat the eggs with the salt and pepper, pour them in and push them around with a spatula until soft, still slightly moist curds form.

steps.sk: Tortilly zohrej 20 sekúnd v suchej panvici, aby boli pružné a nepraskli. Do stredu každej daj fazuľu, vajcia, syr, cibuľku a podľa chuti čili omáčku; nepreplň ich, inak sa nedajú zavinúť.
steps.en: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20 seconds so they are pliable and do not crack. Put the beans, eggs, cheese, spring onion and some chili sauce if you like in the middle of each; do not overfill them or they will not roll.

steps.sk: Bočné okraje preklop dovnútra a tortillu pevne zroluj. Polož ju spojom nadol na panvicu a opekaj na strednom ohni 2 minúty z každej strany, kým nie je zlatistá a syr vnútri sa neroztopí.
steps.en: Fold in the sides and roll the tortilla up tightly. Put it seam side down in the pan and toast over a medium heat for 2 minutes on each side until golden and the cheese inside has melted.

steps.sk: Podávaj rozkrojené našikmo. Do zásoby zabaľ vychladnuté burritá do alobalu: v chladničke vydržia 3 dni, v mrazničke mesiac. Zohrej ich vo fólii v rúre na 180 °C asi 20 minút, z mrazu 35 minút.
steps.en: Serve cut in half on the diagonal. To make ahead, wrap the cooled burritos in foil: they keep for 3 days in the fridge or a month in the freezer. Reheat them in the foil in a 180 °C oven for about 20 minutes, or 35 from frozen.

title.sk: Tamagoyaki – japonská zavinutá omeleta
title.en: Tamagoyaki: Japanese rolled omelette

description.sk: Jemne sladká omeleta zvinutá z tenkých vrstiev, na raňajky aj do krabičky.
description.en: A gently sweet omelette rolled from thin layers, for breakfast or a lunch box.

steps.sk: Vajcia rozbi do misky, pridaj cukor, sójovú omáčku, štipku soli a 2 lyžice vody. Rozmiešaj ich paličkami alebo vidličkou krúživým pohybom po dne misky, aby sa spojili, ale nenapenili – bubliny by v hotovej omeletke nechali dierky.
steps.en: Crack the eggs into a bowl and add the sugar, soy sauce, a pinch of salt and 2 tablespoons of water. Mix with chopsticks or a fork in circles along the bottom of the bowl so they combine without foaming; bubbles would leave holes in the omelette.

steps.sk: Olej nalej do malej misky a priprav si zložený kúsok kuchynskej utierky. Nepriľnavú panvicu (ideálne hranatú) zohrej na strednom ohni a utierkou namočenou v oleji ju potri tenkou vrstvou.
steps.en: Pour the oil into a small dish and have a folded piece of kitchen paper ready. Heat a non-stick pan (ideally a rectangular one) over a medium heat and wipe it with a thin film of oil using the oiled paper.

steps.sk: Vlej asi štvrtinu vajec a nakloň panvicu, aby pokryli celé dno. Keď je vrstva takmer stuhnutá, ale navrchu ešte vlhká, stierkou alebo paličkami ju zroluj od vzdialenejšieho okraja k sebe.
steps.en: Pour in about a quarter of the egg and tilt the pan to cover the base. When the layer is almost set but still moist on top, roll it up from the far edge towards you with a spatula or chopsticks.

steps.sk: Rolku posuň späť na vzdialenejší okraj, panvicu znova potri olejom a vlej ďalšiu štvrtinu vajec. Rolku nadvihni, aby vajce zateklo aj pod ňu, a po stuhnutí zroluj vrstvu okolo nej. Opakuj, kým neminieš všetky vajcia.
steps.en: Push the roll back to the far edge, oil the pan again and pour in the next quarter of egg. Lift the roll so the egg runs underneath it too, and once set, roll the layer around it. Repeat until all the egg is used.

steps.sk: Hotovú rolku zabaľ do kúska papiera na pečenie alebo do bambusovej podložky, jemne ju stlač do tvaru a nechaj 5 minút odpočinúť. Takto drží tvar a pri krájaní sa nerozpadne.
steps.en: Wrap the finished roll in a piece of baking paper or a bamboo mat, press it gently into shape and let it rest for 5 minutes. This way it holds its shape and does not fall apart when sliced.

steps.sk: Nakrájaj ju na plátky hrubé asi 2 cm a podávaj teplú alebo vychladnutú, posypanú jarnou cibuľkou. Do krabičky ju zabaľ až úplne vychladnutú; v chladničke vydrží 2 dni.
steps.en: Cut it into slices about 2 cm thick and serve warm or cold, sprinkled with spring onion. Pack it for lunch only once completely cool; it keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

title.sk: Ryžová kaša congee s vajíčkom a jarnou cibuľkou
title.en: Rice congee with soft egg and spring onion

description.sk: Hodvábna slaná ryžová kaša, ktorá zahreje a je ľahká na žalúdok.
description.en: A silky savoury rice porridge that warms you up and is easy on the stomach.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je takmer číra, a daj ju do veľkého hrnca s 1,5 l vody, bujónom a zázvorom. Priveď do varu a hneď zníž oheň na mierny, aby kaša len jemne prebublávala.
steps.en: Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water is almost clear and put it in a large pan with 1.5 l of water, the stock cube and the ginger. Bring to the boil, then turn the heat down at once so it only bubbles gently.

steps.sk: Var ju pod pootvorenou pokrievkou 50 minút a každých 10 minút ju premiešaj až po dno, aby sa ryža nepripálila. Zrnká sa postupne rozpadnú a kaša zhustne do konzistencie riedkej krupicovej kaše.
steps.en: Simmer it with the lid ajar for 50 minutes, stirring right to the bottom every 10 minutes so the rice does not catch. The grains gradually break down and it thickens to the consistency of a loose semolina porridge.

steps.sk: Asi 10 minút pred koncom priveď v menšom hrnci vodu do varu, lyžicou do nej vlož vajcia a var ich presne 6 a pol minúty. Potom ich prelož do studenej vody s ľadom – žĺtok tak zostane krémový a vajcia sa ľahšie ošúpu.
steps.en: About 10 minutes before the end, bring a small pan of water to the boil, lower in the eggs with a spoon and boil them for exactly 6½ minutes. Then move them to iced water so the yolks stay creamy and the eggs peel more easily.

steps.sk: Jarnú cibuľku nakrájaj na tenké kolieska. Kašu dochuť sójovou omáčkou a soľou; ak je príliš hustá, prilej trochu horúcej vody, ak je riedka, var ju ešte pár minút bez pokrievky.
steps.en: Thinly slice the spring onions. Season the congee with the soy sauce and salt; if it is too thick add a little hot water, and if too thin, simmer it uncovered for a few more minutes.

steps.sk: Kašu rozdeľ do misiek, na každú polož ošúpané rozpolené vajce, posyp cibuľkou, pokvapkaj sezamovým olejom a podľa chuti čili. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni; pri zohrievaní ju rozrieď vodou, lebo stuhne.
steps.en: Ladle the congee into bowls, top each with a peeled halved egg, sprinkle with spring onion, drizzle with sesame oil and add chili if you like. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days; thin it with water when reheating, as it sets.

title.sk: Upma – indická krupicová kaša so zeleninou
title.en: Upma: Indian savoury semolina with vegetables

description.sk: Slaná kaša z opraženej krupice s horčičným korením, zeleninou a citrónom.
description.en: A savoury porridge of toasted semolina with spices, vegetables and lemon.

steps.sk: Krupicu nasyp do suchej panvice a na strednom ohni ju za stáleho miešania praž 5 minút, kým nezavonia a jemne nezožltne. Prelož ju do misky – opražená krupica sa neskôr nezlepí do hrudiek.
steps.en: Tip the semolina into a dry frying pan and toast it over a medium heat, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes until fragrant and faintly golden. Transfer it to a bowl; toasted semolina will not clump into lumps later.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno, mrkvu na kocky asi 5 mm a čili na kolieska. V tej istej panvici zohrej olej, pridaj rascu (kmín) a kešu a opekaj 1 minútu, kým orechy nezozlatnú; potom pridaj cibuľu, zázvor a čili.
steps.en: Finely chop the onion, dice the carrot into 5 mm cubes and slice the chili. Heat the oil in the same pan, add the cumin and cashews and fry for 1 minute until the nuts turn golden, then add the onion, ginger and chili.

steps.sk: Opekaj 4 minúty, kým cibuľa nezmäkne, pridaj mrkvu a hrášok a miešaj ďalšie 3 minúty. Prilej 450 ml vody, pridaj soľ a kurkumu a priveď do varu; ochutnaj – voda má byť slaná o niečo viac, ako chceš mať kašu.
steps.en: Fry for 4 minutes until the onion softens, add the carrot and peas and stir for 3 minutes more. Pour in 450 ml of water, add the salt and turmeric and bring to the boil; taste it, the water should be slightly saltier than you want the upma.

steps.sk: Zníž oheň a krupicu sypaj do vriacej vody tenkým prúdom, pričom jednou rukou neustále mieša varechou. Toto je najdôležitejší krok – ak ju nasypeš naraz, vzniknú hrudky.
steps.en: Lower the heat and pour the semolina into the boiling water in a thin stream while stirring constantly with a wooden spoon. This is the crucial step: tip it in all at once and it turns lumpy.

steps.sk: Miešaj ešte 2 minúty, kým kaša nezhustne a neodlepuje sa od dna. Panvicu stiahni z ohňa, prikry ju a nechaj 3 minúty postáť, aby krupica dobre napučala.
steps.en: Keep stirring for 2 minutes until the upma thickens and comes away from the base of the pan. Take it off the heat, cover and leave for 3 minutes so the semolina swells fully.

steps.sk: Pokvapkaj ju citrónovou šťavou, posyp koriandrom a vidličkou ju zľahka nakypri. Podávaj teplú; je sýta a jemná, ideálna na chladné ráno. Zvyšok vydrží v chladničke 2 dni.
steps.en: Sprinkle with the lemon juice and coriander and fluff it lightly with a fork. Serve warm; it is filling yet mild, ideal on a cold morning. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days.

title.sk: Anda bhurji – indická korenistá praženica
title.en: Anda bhurji: Indian spiced scrambled eggs

description.sk: Praženica s cibuľou, paradajkou, zázvorom a garam masalou, ktorá sa je s rožkom.
description.en: Scrambled eggs with onion, tomato, ginger and garam masala, eaten with soft rolls.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na drobné kocky, paradajku na kocky asi 1 cm a čili na tenké kolieska. Cesnak prelisuj. Vajcia rozšľahaj v miske s polovicou soli – nie dlho, len kým sa bielky spoja so žĺtkami.
steps.en: Finely dice the onion, cut the tomato into roughly 1 cm cubes and thinly slice the chili. Crush the garlic. Beat the eggs in a bowl with half the salt, just until the whites and yolks combine.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozpusti maslo na strednom ohni a opekaj cibuľu 5 minút, kým nie je mäkká a na okrajoch zlatistá. Pridaj zázvor, cesnak a čili a miešaj 1 minútu, kým nezavoňajú; cesnak nesmie zhnednúť.
steps.en: Melt the butter in a frying pan over a medium heat and fry the onion for 5 minutes until soft and golden at the edges. Add the ginger, garlic and chili and stir for 1 minute until fragrant; the garlic must not brown.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajku, kurkumu, garam masalu a zvyšok soli a nechaj 3 minúty dusiť, kým sa paradajka nerozpadne na hustú omáčku. Táto základňa nesie celú chuť jedla, preto ju neskracuj.
steps.en: Add the tomato, turmeric, garam masala and the rest of the salt and cook for 3 minutes until the tomato breaks down into a thick sauce. This base carries all the flavour, so do not cut it short.

steps.sk: Zníž oheň na mierny, vlej vajcia a nechaj ich 20 sekúnd stáť. Potom ich varechou pomaly premiešavaj, kým nevzniknú mäkké vločky prestúpené korenenou zmesou – asi 2 až 3 minúty.
steps.en: Turn the heat down to low, pour in the eggs and leave them for 20 seconds. Then stir slowly with a wooden spoon until soft curds form, streaked with the spiced base; about 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Stiahni panvicu z ohňa, kým sú vajcia ešte vláčne, a posyp ich koriandrom. Rožky rozkroj a opeč ich reznou stranou na suchej panvici dozlatista – v Indii sa takto podáva pouličné bhurji.
steps.en: Take the pan off the heat while the eggs are still moist and scatter with coriander. Split the rolls and toast them cut side down in a dry pan until golden; that is how street-style bhurji is served in India.

steps.sk: Podávaj praženicu hneď s opečenými rožkami alebo s chlebom. Ak chceš menej pikantnú verziu, vynechaj čili a pridaj namiesto neho štipku sladkej papriky.
steps.en: Serve the eggs at once with the toasted rolls or with bread. For a milder version, leave out the chili and add a pinch of sweet paprika instead.

title.sk: Zelená šakšuka so špenátom a fetou
title.en: Green shakshuka with spinach and feta

description.sk: Vajcia zapečené v pórovo-špenátovej zmesi s rascou a citrónom.
description.en: Eggs baked in a leek and spinach base with cumin and lemon.

steps.sk: Pór rozkroj pozdĺžne, dôkladne ho umy medzi listami, kde sa drží piesok, a nakrájaj ho na tenké polkolieska. Cesnak nakrájaj na plátky. Špenát umy a nechaj odkvapkať.
steps.en: Halve the leek lengthways, wash it well between the layers where grit hides and slice it into thin half-moons. Slice the garlic. Wash the spinach and leave it to drain.

steps.sk: V širokej panvici s pokrievkou zohrej olej na strednom ohni a opekaj pór 6 minút, kým nezmäkne a nezosladne – nemá zhnednúť. Pridaj cesnak a rascu (kmín) a miešaj 1 minútu.
steps.en: Heat the oil over a medium heat in a wide pan that has a lid and fry the leek for 6 minutes until soft and sweet; it should not brown. Add the garlic and cumin and stir for 1 minute.

steps.sk: Pridávaj špenát po hrstiach a nechaj každú zvädnúť, kým pridáš ďalšiu, spolu asi 3 minúty. Osoľ, okoreň a pokvapkaj citrónovou šťavou; ak sa na dne drží veľa vody, nechaj ju minútu odpariť.
steps.en: Add the spinach a handful at a time, letting each one wilt before adding the next, about 3 minutes in all. Season with the salt, pepper and lemon juice; if there is a lot of liquid in the pan, let it bubble off for a minute.

steps.sk: Lyžicou urob v zelenine 4 jamky a do každej rozbi vajce. Panvicu prikry a var na miernom ohni 6 až 8 minút, kým bielky celkom nestuhnú a žĺtky sú ešte tekuté.
steps.en: Make 4 hollows in the greens with a spoon and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook over a low heat for 6 to 8 minutes until the whites are completely set and the yolks still runny.

steps.sk: Na vajcia rozdrob fetu a podľa chuti posyp čili vločkami. Kontroluj bielky pri žĺtku – práve tam tuhnú najdlhšie; ak sú ešte priesvitné, nechaj panvicu prikrytú ešte minútu.
steps.en: Crumble the feta over the eggs and add chili flakes if you like. Check the white around the yolk, where it sets last; if it is still translucent, keep the lid on for another minute.

steps.sk: Podávaj priamo z panvice s teplou pitou, ktorou naberáš zeleninu so žĺtkom. Šakšuka je najlepšia hneď; zohrievaním by žĺtky stuhli.
steps.en: Serve straight from the pan with warm pita to scoop up the greens and yolk. Shakshuka is best eaten at once; reheating would set the yolks.

title.sk: Menemen – turecké vajcia s paprikou a paradajkami
title.en: Menemen: Turkish eggs with peppers and tomatoes

description.sk: Šťavnaté miešané vajcia v duseninke z papriky a paradajok.
description.en: Juicy soft-scrambled eggs in a stew of peppers and tomatoes.

steps.sk: Papriky zbav semienok a nakrájaj na tenké prúžky. Paradajky rozkroj na polovice a nastrúhaj ich reznou stranou na hrubom strúhadle do misky; šupka ti zostane v ruke a môžeš ju vyhodiť.
steps.en: Seed the peppers and cut them into thin strips. Halve the tomatoes and grate them, cut side down, on the coarse side of a grater into a bowl; the skin stays in your hand and can be thrown away.

steps.sk: V panvici zohrej olej s maslom na strednom ohni a papriky dus 6 až 8 minút, kým úplne nezmäknú a miestami nezhnednú. Mäkké papriky sú základ – tvrdé by sa s vajcami nespojili.
steps.en: Heat the oil and butter in a frying pan over a medium heat and cook the peppers for 6 to 8 minutes until completely soft and browned in places. Soft peppers are the foundation; firm ones would not meld with the eggs.

steps.sk: Pridaj nastrúhané paradajky, sladkú papriku a soľ a var bez pokrievky asi 8 minút, kým sa šťava odparí a zmes zhustne na lesklú omáčku. Ochutnaj, mala by byť sladká a výrazná.
steps.en: Add the grated tomatoes, sweet paprika and salt and simmer uncovered for about 8 minutes until the juice evaporates and the mixture thickens into a glossy sauce. Taste it: it should be sweet and full of flavour.

steps.sk: Zníž oheň, rozbi vajcia priamo do panvice a nechaj ich 30 sekúnd stáť. Potom ich len niekoľkokrát zľahka premiešaj, aby zostali kúsky bielka a žĺtka – menemen nemá byť jednoliata praženica.
steps.en: Lower the heat, crack the eggs straight into the pan and leave them for 30 seconds. Then stir gently just a few times so streaks of white and yolk remain; menemen should not be a uniform scramble.

steps.sk: Var ešte 2 až 3 minúty, kým vajcia nie sú takmer stuhnuté, ale stále vláčne, a stiahni panvicu z ohňa. Posyp čili vločkami a čerstvo mletým korením.
steps.en: Cook for 2 to 3 minutes more until the eggs are almost set but still soft, then take the pan off the heat. Sprinkle with the chili flakes and freshly ground pepper.

steps.sk: Podávaj hneď v panvici s chlebom, ktorým sa šťava vytiera do posledného kúska. Je to raňajky, ktoré nepočkajú – zohriate vajcia zgumovatejú.
steps.en: Serve at once in the pan with bread to wipe up every last bit of the juices. This is a breakfast that will not wait: reheated, the eggs turn rubbery.

title.sk: Toast s ricottou, hruškou a medom
title.en: Ricotta toast with pear and honey

description.sk: Chrumkavý celozrnný chlieb, krémová ricotta, šťavnatá hruška a orechy.
description.en: Crisp wholegrain toast, creamy ricotta, juicy pear and walnuts.

steps.sk: Krajce chleba opeč v hriankovači alebo na suchej panvici z oboch strán, kým nie sú chrumkavé a zlatisté. Chrumkavý chlieb je dôležitý – mäkký by pod ricottou zvlhol.
steps.en: Toast the slices of bread in a toaster or on both sides in a dry pan until crisp and golden. Crisp bread matters: soft bread would go soggy under the ricotta.

steps.sk: Hrušku umy, rozštvrť, vykroj jadrovník a nakrájaj ju na tenké plátky. Hneď ju pokvapkaj citrónovou šťavou a premiešaj – nezhnedne a dostane sviežu chuť.
steps.en: Wash the pear, quarter it, cut out the core and slice it thinly. Toss it straight away with the lemon juice so it does not brown and tastes fresh.

steps.sk: Ricottu rozmiešaj v miske so štipkou soli do hladka; soľ zvýrazní jej mliečnu sladkosť. Orechy nahrubo nalámaj, a ak máš čas, opraž ich 2 minúty na suchej panvici.
steps.en: Stir the ricotta in a bowl with a pinch of salt until smooth; the salt brings out its milky sweetness. Break up the walnuts roughly and, if you have time, toast them in a dry pan for 2 minutes.

steps.sk: Na každý krajec natri hrubú vrstvu ricotty, navrch poukladaj plátky hrušky ako vejár, posyp orechmi, pokvapkaj medom a pridaj štipku čierneho korenia. Jedz hneď, kým je chlieb chrumkavý.
steps.en: Spread a thick layer of ricotta on each slice, fan the pear on top, scatter with the walnuts, drizzle with honey and add a pinch of black pepper. Eat at once while the toast is crisp.

title.sk: Zeleninová frittata z rúry
title.en: Oven-baked vegetable frittata

description.sk: Hrubá talianska omeleta plná zeleniny, ktorá chutí teplá aj studená.
description.en: A thick Italian omelette full of vegetables, as good warm as cold.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C. Cuketu nakrájaj na polkolieska hrubé asi 5 mm, papriku na prúžky a červenú cibuľu na tenké mesiačiky. Cherry paradajky rozpoľ a parmezán nastrúhaj najemno.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Slice the zucchini into half-moons about 5 mm thick, the pepper into strips and the red onion into thin wedges. Halve the cherry tomatoes and finely grate the parmesan.

steps.sk: V panvici, ktorá znesie rúru (aspoň 24 cm), zohrej olej na strednom ohni a opekaj cibuľu, papriku a cuketu 6 až 8 minút, kým nezmäknú a miestami nezhnednú. Pridaj štipku soli – odparí sa z nich voda, ktorá by inak frittatu rozmočila.
steps.en: In an ovenproof frying pan (at least 24 cm), heat the oil over a medium heat and fry the onion, pepper and zucchini for 6 to 8 minutes until soft and browned in places. Add a pinch of salt; it drives off water that would otherwise make the frittata soggy.

steps.sk: Vajcia rozšľahaj v miske s mliekom, zvyšnou soľou, korením a dvoma tretinami parmezánu, kým sa bielky úplne nespoja so žĺtkami. Nešľahaj ich dlho – vzduch by frittatu nafúkol a potom by spľasla.
steps.en: Beat the eggs in a bowl with the milk, the remaining salt, the pepper and two thirds of the parmesan until the whites and yolks are fully combined. Do not whisk for long; air would puff the frittata up and then it would collapse.

steps.sk: Zníž oheň na mierny, zeleninu rovnomerne rozprestri a zalej ju vajcami. Navrch poukladaj paradajky reznou stranou nahor a posyp zvyšným parmezánom; nechaj 3 minúty na ohni, kým okraje nezačnú tuhnúť.
steps.en: Turn the heat to low, spread the vegetables evenly and pour the eggs over them. Arrange the tomatoes on top, cut side up, and sprinkle with the rest of the parmesan; leave on the heat for 3 minutes until the edges start to set.

steps.sk: Panvicu prelož do rúry a peč 12 až 15 minút, kým frittata nie je nafúknutá, navrchu zlatistá a v strede pevná – pri zatrasení panvicou sa už nehýbe. Nôž zapichnutý do stredu má vyjsť čistý.
steps.en: Move the pan to the oven and bake for 12 to 15 minutes until puffed, golden on top and firm in the middle: it no longer wobbles when you shake the pan. A knife pushed into the centre should come out clean.

steps.sk: Nechaj ju 5 minút odpočinúť, uvoľni okraje stierkou, nakrájaj ju na 4 dieliky a posyp bazalkou. Je dobrá teplá aj studená a v chladničke vydrží 3 dni, takže sa hodí aj do krabičky na obed.
steps.en: Let it rest for 5 minutes, loosen the edges with a spatula, cut it into 4 wedges and scatter with basil. It is good warm or cold and keeps in the fridge for 3 days, so it works well in a lunch box too.

title.sk: Croque monsieur – zapečený toast so šunkou a syrom
title.en: Croque monsieur: baked ham and cheese toast

description.sk: Parížska klasika: opečený sendvič so šunkou, zapečený pod béšamelom a syrom.
description.en: A Parisian classic: a toasted ham sandwich baked under béchamel and cheese.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C s horným ohrevom (gril) a plech vystel papierom na pečenie. Syr nastrúhaj nahrubo a rozdeľ ho na štyri diely: jeden do omáčky, dva do sendvičov a jeden navrch.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C with the top heat (grill) and line a tray with baking paper. Coarsely grate the cheese and divide it into four portions: one for the sauce, two for the sandwiches and one for the top.

steps.sk: Na béšamel rozpusti v malom hrnci polovicu masla, vmiešaj múku a 1 minútu ju na miernom ohni miešaj, aby stratila surovú chuť. Postupne prilievaj mlieko a metlou miešaj, kým nevznikne hladká hustá omáčka; trvá to asi 3 minúty.
steps.en: For the béchamel, melt half the butter in a small pan, stir in the flour and cook it over a low heat for 1 minute so it loses its raw taste. Gradually pour in the milk, whisking, until you have a smooth thick sauce; it takes about 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Omáčku dochuť štipkou soli, korenia a muškátového orieška a vmiešaj do nej štvrtinu syra. Ak má hrudky, prešľahaj ju metlou ešte chvíľu na ohni; hustá omáčka sa na chlebe neroztečie.
steps.en: Season the sauce with a pinch of salt, pepper and nutmeg and stir in a quarter of the cheese. If it is lumpy, whisk it a little longer over the heat; a thick sauce will not run off the bread.

steps.sk: Dva krajce chleba natri tenko horčicou, polož na ne šunku a polovicu syra a prikry ich zvyšnými krajcami. Sendviče zvonka potri zvyšným maslom a na panvici ich opeč na strednom ohni 2 minúty z každej strany dozlatista.
steps.en: Spread two slices of bread thinly with mustard, top with the ham and half the cheese and cover with the other slices. Butter the outsides with the rest of the butter and toast the sandwiches in a frying pan over a medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden.

steps.sk: Opečené sendviče prelož na plech, navrch rozotri béšamel a posyp ich zvyšným syrom. Zapekaj pod grilom 5 až 6 minút, kým syr nebublá a nie je miestami zlatohnedý; stráž ich, pod grilom sa pripália rýchlo.
steps.en: Move the toasted sandwiches to the tray, spread the béchamel on top and sprinkle with the remaining cheese. Grill for 5 to 6 minutes until the cheese bubbles and is golden brown in places; watch them, under the grill they burn quickly.

steps.sk: Nechaj ich minútu vychladnúť, aby sa omáčka trochu stiahla, a rozkroj ich šikmo na polovice. Podávaj teplé so zeleným šalátom alebo s kyslou uhorkou, ktoré vyvážia výdatnú chuť.
steps.en: Let them cool for a minute so the sauce firms slightly, then cut them diagonally in half. Serve warm with a green salad or a pickle to balance the richness.

title.sk: Pan con tomate s volským okom
title.en: Pan con tomate with a fried egg

description.sk: Chrumkavý chlieb s cesnakom, nastrúhanou paradajkou, olivovým olejom a vajcom.
description.en: Crisp bread with garlic, grated tomato, olive oil and an egg.

steps.sk: Paradajky rozkroj na polovice a nastrúhaj ich reznou stranou na hrubom strúhadle do misky, kým ti v ruke nezostane len šupka. Pyré premiešaj so štipkou soli a 1 lyžicou olivového oleja.
steps.en: Halve the tomatoes and grate them, cut side down, on the coarse side of a grater into a bowl until only the skin is left in your hand. Mix the pulp with a pinch of salt and 1 tablespoon of the olive oil.

steps.sk: Krajce chleba opeč na suchej panvici alebo v hriankovači, kým nie sú zvonka chrumkavé, no vnútri ešte mäkké. Teplé krajce potri z jednej strany prekrojeným strúčikom cesnaku – drsný povrch ho zachytí.
steps.en: Toast the slices of bread in a dry pan or a toaster until crisp outside but still soft within. Rub one side of each warm slice with the cut clove of garlic; the rough surface catches it.

steps.sk: Na panvici zohrej 1 lyžicu oleja na strednom ohni, rozbi do nej vajcia a opekaj ich 3 minúty, kým bielok nestuhne a okraje nie sú chrumkavé, ale žĺtok zostane tekutý. Lyžicou ich polievaj horúcim olejom, aby bielok navrchu dotuhol.
steps.en: Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat, crack in the eggs and fry them for 3 minutes until the whites are set and the edges crisp but the yolks still runny. Spoon the hot oil over them so the whites set on top.

steps.sk: Na krajce rozotri paradajkové pyré aj so šťavou, pokvapkaj ich zvyšným olejom a posyp štipkou soli. Na dva krajce polož vajcia, okoreň ich a podľa chuti posyp údenou paprikou.
steps.en: Spread the tomato pulp and its juice over the bread, drizzle with the rest of the oil and sprinkle with a pinch of salt. Put the eggs on two of the slices, season with pepper and add smoked paprika if you like.

steps.sk: Podávaj hneď, kým je chlieb ešte chrumkavý – paradajka ho postupne rozmáča. Ostatné dva krajce s paradajkou podávaj vedľa; v Katalánsku sa takto raňajkuje takmer každý deň.
steps.en: Serve at once while the bread is still crisp; the tomato gradually softens it. Serve the other two tomato slices alongside; in Catalonia this is an almost everyday breakfast.

title.sk: Kórejský raňajkový toast s kapustovou omeletou
title.en: Korean street toast with cabbage omelette

description.sk: Pouličný sendvič zo Soulu: maslový toast, omeleta s kapustou, šunka, syr a kečup.
description.en: A Seoul street sandwich: buttery toast, cabbage omelette, ham, cheese and ketchup.

steps.sk: Kapustu nakrájaj na veľmi tenké rezance (asi 2 mm), mrkvu nastrúhaj nahrubo a jarnú cibuľku nakrájaj na kolieska. Vajcia rozšľahaj so štipkou soli a zeleninu do nich vmiešaj – zmes má byť hustá, viac zeleniny ako vajec.
steps.en: Cut the cabbage into very thin shreds (about 2 mm), coarsely grate the carrot and slice the spring onion. Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and stir in the vegetables; the mixture should be thick, more vegetable than egg.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozpusti polovicu masla a opeč na ňom krajce chleba na miernom ohni z oboch strán dozlatista, asi 2 minúty z každej strany. Prelož ich na tanier a jednu stranu každého krajca posyp cukrom.
steps.en: Melt half the butter in a frying pan and toast the slices of bread in it over a low heat on both sides until golden, about 2 minutes a side. Transfer them to a plate and sprinkle one side of each slice with sugar.

steps.sk: Do panvice daj zvyšné maslo, vlej polovicu vaječnej zmesi a stierkou ju sformuj do štvorca veľkého ako krajec chleba. Opekaj na strednom ohni 2 až 3 minúty, obráť a opekaj ďalšie 2 minúty, kým nie je omeleta pevná a kapusta mäkká; rovnako opeč zvyšok.
steps.en: Add the rest of the butter to the pan, pour in half the egg mixture and shape it with a spatula into a square the size of a slice of bread. Fry over a medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes, flip and fry for 2 minutes more until the omelette is firm and the cabbage soft; cook the rest the same way.

steps.sk: Na pocukrovanú stranu krajca polož omeletu, plátok šunky a syra, pokvapkaj ich kečupom a podľa chuti majonézou a prikry druhým krajcom cukrom dovnútra. Teplo omelety syr jemne roztopí.
steps.en: Lay an omelette on the sugared side of a slice, add a slice each of ham and cheese, drizzle with ketchup and mayonnaise if you like and cover with a second slice, sugar side in. The heat of the omelette gently melts the cheese.

steps.sk: Toast stlač dlaňou, rozkroj ho na polovice a podávaj hneď, najlepšie zabalený do papiera ako na ulici. Sladkosť cukru a kečupu so slanou omeletou je zámerná – patrí k typickej chuti.
steps.en: Press the toast down with your palm, cut it in half and serve at once, ideally wrapped in paper as on the street. The sweetness of the sugar and ketchup against the savoury omelette is deliberate; it is the classic taste.

title.sk: Banánové lievance z ovsených vločiek
title.en: Banana oat pancakes

description.sk: Sladké vďaka zrelým banánom, bez múky a bez pridaného cukru.
description.en: Sweetened by ripe bananas, with no flour and no added sugar.

steps.sk: Banány ošúp a v miske ich roztlač vidličkou na hladké pyré – čím sú zrelšie a tmavšie, tým sú lievance sladšie, takže cukor netreba. Pridaj vajcia a rozšľahaj ich s banánom do peny.
steps.en: Peel the bananas and mash them in a bowl with a fork into a smooth purée; the riper and darker they are, the sweeter the pancakes, so no sugar is needed. Add the eggs and whisk them with the banana until frothy.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj ovsené vločky, prášok do pečiva, škoricu a štipku soli. Cesto nechaj 10 minút odpočinúť, aby vločky nasali tekutinu a zmäkli; zhustne a lievance sa potom nebudú rozpadávať.
steps.en: Stir in the oats, baking powder, cinnamon and a pinch of salt. Let the batter rest for 10 minutes so the oats soak up the liquid and soften; it thickens and the pancakes will not fall apart.

steps.sk: Nepriľnavú panvicu zohrej na strednom ohni a potri ju tenko olejom. Nakladaj na ňu po lyžici cesta a jemne ho roztieraj na placky s priemerom asi 8 cm a hrúbkou 1 cm.
steps.en: Heat a non-stick pan over a medium heat and brush it thinly with oil. Drop in spoonfuls of batter and spread them gently into pancakes about 8 cm across and 1 cm thick.

steps.sk: Peč ich 2 až 3 minúty, kým sa na povrchu neurobia bublinky a spodok nie je zlatohnedý, potom ich obráť a peč ešte 2 minúty. Banán sa rýchlo pripáli, preto ak tmavnú príliš skoro, zníž oheň.
steps.en: Cook them for 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles appear on top and the underside is golden brown, then flip and cook for 2 minutes more. Banana burns easily, so if they darken too soon, turn the heat down.

steps.sk: Podávaj ich teplé s gréckym jogurtom a čučoriedkami. Vychladnuté lievance vydržia v chladničke 2 dni a dajú sa zohriať v hriankovači alebo na suchej panvici.
steps.en: Serve them warm with Greek yogurt and blueberries. Cooled pancakes keep in the fridge for 2 days and can be reheated in a toaster or a dry pan.

title.sk: Kakaový chia puding s malinami
title.en: Cocoa chia pudding with raspberries

description.sk: Čokoládový puding bez varenia, ktorý sa pripraví večer a ráno čaká hotový.
description.en: A no-cook chocolate pudding made the night before and ready in the morning.

steps.sk: Do misky nalej mlieko, pridaj kakao, med, vanilkový cukor a štipku soli a metlou dôkladne prešľahaj, kým sa kakao celé nerozpustí. Hrudky kakaa by v pudingu zostali suché a horké.
steps.en: Pour the milk into a bowl, add the cocoa, honey, vanilla sugar and a pinch of salt and whisk thoroughly until the cocoa has completely dissolved. Lumps of cocoa would stay dry and bitter in the pudding.

steps.sk: Vsyp chia semienka a miešaj asi minútu, aby sa rovnomerne rozptýlili. Nechaj zmes 10 minút stáť a potom ju znova poriadne premiešaj – práve vtedy majú semienka sklon zlepiť sa do hrudiek.
steps.en: Add the chia seeds and stir for about a minute so they are evenly spread. Leave the mixture for 10 minutes, then stir it well again; this is when the seeds tend to clump together.

steps.sk: Puding rozdeľ do dvoch pohárov alebo uzatvárateľných nádob a daj ho aspoň na 4 hodiny, najlepšie cez noc, do chladničky. Chia semienka napučia a zmes zhustne na krémovú konzistenciu.
steps.en: Divide the pudding between two glasses or lidded containers and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, ideally overnight. The chia seeds swell and the mixture thickens to a creamy consistency.

steps.sk: Pred podávaním puding premiešaj; ak je príliš hustý, rozrieď ho lyžicou mlieka. Navrch daj maliny – polovicu môžeš roztlačiť vidličkou na rýchly džem – a posyp ho nasekanými mandľami.
steps.en: Stir the pudding before serving; if it is too thick, loosen it with a spoonful of milk. Top with the raspberries, mashing half of them with a fork into a quick jam if you like, and scatter with chopped almonds.

steps.sk: V chladničke vydrží 3 dni, takže si ho môžeš pripraviť na niekoľko rán naraz. Ovocie pridávaj až v deň jedenia, aby nepustilo šťavu do pudingu a nerozmočilo ho.
steps.en: It keeps in the fridge for 3 days, so you can make several mornings' worth at once. Add the fruit only on the day you eat it so its juice does not seep into the pudding and make it watery.

title.sk: Jablkové muffiny s ovsenými vločkami
title.en: Apple and oat muffins

description.sk: Vláčne muffiny s jablkom a škoricou na raňajky do ruky.
description.en: Moist apple and cinnamon muffins for breakfast on the go.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C a formu na 12 muffinov vylož papierovými košíčkami alebo ju vymasti olejom. Jablká umy, vykroj jadrovníky a nastrúhaj ich nahrubo aj so šupkou; šťavu z nich nevyžímaj, muffiny ju potrebujú.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C and line a 12-hole muffin tin with paper cases or grease it with oil. Wash the apples, cut out the cores and coarsely grate them, skin and all; do not squeeze out the juice, the muffins need it.

steps.sk: Vo veľkej miske zmiešaj múku, ovsené vločky, hnedý cukor, prášok do pečiva, škoricu a soľ. V druhej miske rozšľahaj vajcia s mliekom a olejom, kým sa olej nespojí s ostatnou tekutinou.
steps.en: In a large bowl, mix the flour, oats, brown sugar, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. In a second bowl, whisk the eggs with the milk and oil until the oil combines with the rest of the liquid.

steps.sk: Tekutú zmes vlej do suchej, pridaj jablká a vareškou len zľahka premiešaj, kým nezmiznú suché miesta – pár hrudiek nevadí. Dlhým miešaním by sa vytvoril lepok a muffiny by boli tuhé a gumové.
steps.en: Pour the wet mixture into the dry one, add the apples and stir gently with a wooden spoon just until no dry patches remain; a few lumps are fine. Long mixing develops the gluten and makes the muffins tough and rubbery.

steps.sk: Cesto rozdeľ do košíčkov asi do troch štvrtín výšky a posyp ho nasekanými orechmi. Peč 20 až 22 minút, kým muffiny nie sú klenuté a zlatisté a špajdľa zapichnutá do stredu nevyjde čistá.
steps.en: Divide the batter between the cases, filling them about three-quarters full, and sprinkle with chopped walnuts. Bake for 20 to 22 minutes until domed and golden and a skewer pushed into the middle comes out clean.

steps.sk: Nechaj ich 5 minút vo forme, potom ich prelož na mriežku, aby spodky nezvlhli. Vydržia 3 dni v uzavretej nádobe alebo mesiac v mrazničke; ráno ich stačí 20 sekúnd zohriať v mikrovlnke.
steps.en: Leave them in the tin for 5 minutes, then move them to a rack so the bottoms do not go soggy. They keep for 3 days in an airtight box or a month in the freezer; in the morning, 20 seconds in the microwave is enough.

title.sk: Smoothie miska s lesným ovocím a banánom
title.en: Berry and banana smoothie bowl

description.sk: Hustý mrazený krém z ovocia a jogurtu s chrumkavým posypom.
description.en: A thick frozen cream of fruit and yogurt with a crunchy topping.

steps.sk: Banán ošúp a nakrájaj na kolieska; niekoľko si odlož na ozdobu. Ak máš čas, zvyšok daj aspoň na 2 hodiny do mrazničky – zmrazený banán urobí zo smoothie hustý krém podobný zmrzline.
steps.en: Peel the banana and slice it, keeping a few slices for the top. If you have time, freeze the rest for at least 2 hours; frozen banana turns the smoothie into a thick cream much like ice cream.

steps.sk: Do mixéra daj mrazené ovocie, banán, jogurt a mlieko. Mixuj na nízkych otáčkach a postupne ich zvyšuj; ak sa nože točia naprázdno, zastav mixér, zmes premiešaj lyžicou a pridaj lyžicu mlieka.
steps.en: Put the frozen berries, banana, yogurt and milk in the blender. Blend on low and gradually increase the speed; if the blades spin freely, stop, stir the mixture with a spoon and add a spoonful of milk.

steps.sk: Smoothie má byť také husté, že v ňom lyžica chvíľu stojí – riedke by sa s posypom nedalo jesť lyžicou. Ak je príliš riedke, pridaj ešte hrsť mrazeného ovocia a krátko ho premixuj.
steps.en: The smoothie should be thick enough for a spoon to stand in it for a moment; a runny one could not be eaten with a spoon under the topping. If it is too thin, add another handful of frozen fruit and blend briefly.

steps.sk: Prelej ho do misky, navrch poukladaj kolieska banánu, ovsené vločky, chia semienka a strúhaný kokos a pokvapkaj ho medom. Jedz hneď, kým je studené a husté; postátím sa roztopí.
steps.en: Spoon it into a bowl, top with the banana slices, oats, chia seeds and coconut and drizzle with honey. Eat at once while it is cold and thick; left to stand it melts.

title.sk: Çılbır – stratené vajcia na cesnakovom jogurte
title.en: Çılbır: poached eggs on garlic yogurt

description.sk: Turecké raňajky: mäkké vajcia, chladivý jogurt a horúce paprikové maslo.
description.en: A Turkish breakfast of soft eggs, cool yogurt and hot paprika butter.

steps.sk: Jogurt vyber z chladničky aspoň 15 minút vopred, aby nebol ľadový. Cesnak prelisuj a vmiešaj ho do jogurtu so štipkou soli; jogurt potom rozotri do dvoch hlbších tanierov.
steps.en: Take the yogurt out of the fridge at least 15 minutes ahead so it is not ice-cold. Crush the garlic and stir it into the yogurt with a pinch of salt, then spread the yogurt over two shallow bowls.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci priveď do varu asi 1,5 l vody s octom a zníž oheň tak, aby voda len jemne bublala. Každé vajce rozbi najprv do malej misky alebo cez jemné sitko – odtečie tak riedka časť bielka, ktorá by sa rozplávala.
steps.en: Bring about 1.5 l of water with the vinegar to the boil in a wide pan and lower the heat so it barely bubbles. Crack each egg first into a small cup or through a fine sieve; this drains off the thin part of the white that would otherwise drift apart.

steps.sk: Vodu lyžicou roztoč do víru a do stredu opatrne vkĺzni vajce. Var ho 3 minúty, kým bielok nestuhne a žĺtok zostane mäkký, potom ho dierovanou lyžicou vylov a polož na utierku, aby odkvapkalo. Rovnako uvar ostatné.
steps.en: Swirl the water into a whirlpool with a spoon and gently slide an egg into the centre. Cook it for 3 minutes until the white is set and the yolk still soft, then lift it out with a slotted spoon onto kitchen paper to drain. Cook the rest the same way.

steps.sk: Na malej panvici rozpusti maslo na miernom ohni, kým nezačne peniť a orieškovo voňať, a stiahni ho z ohňa. Vmiešaj sladkú papriku a čili vločky – horúce maslo sa zafarbí dosýta červena, no paprika sa nesmie pripáliť.
steps.en: Melt the butter in a small pan over a low heat until it foams and smells nutty, then take it off the heat. Stir in the sweet paprika and chili flakes; the hot butter turns deep red, but the paprika must not burn.

steps.sk: Na jogurt polož po dve vajcia, zalej ich paprikovým maslom, osoľ zvyšnou soľou a posyp kôprom. Podávaj hneď s chlebom, ktorým naberáš jogurt so žĺtkom.
steps.en: Set two eggs on each bowl of yogurt, pour the paprika butter over them, season with the remaining salt and scatter with dill. Serve at once with bread to scoop up the yogurt and yolk.

title.sk: Quinoa kaša s kokosovým mliekom a mangom
title.en: Coconut quinoa porridge with mango

description.sk: Krémová kaša z quinoy s kokosom, ktorá chutí ako dovolenka.
description.en: A creamy coconut quinoa porridge that tastes like a holiday.

steps.sk: Quinou prepláchni v jemnom sitku pod tečúcou vodou asi minútu a pri tom ju prstami premiešavaj. Zmyješ tak saponíny na povrchu zrniek, ktoré by kaši dali horkú, mydlovú pachuť.
steps.en: Rinse the quinoa in a fine sieve under running water for about a minute, stirring it with your fingers. This washes off the saponins coating the seeds, which would give the porridge a bitter, soapy taste.

steps.sk: Daj ju do hrnca s kokosovým mliekom, 150 ml mlieka, škoricou a štipkou soli, priveď do varu a zníž oheň na minimum. Var prikryté 15 minút a občas premiešaj, aby sa kokosové mlieko nepripálilo.
steps.en: Put it in a pan with the coconut milk, 150 ml of the milk, the cinnamon and a pinch of salt, bring to the boil and turn the heat right down. Simmer, covered, for 15 minutes, stirring now and then so the coconut milk does not catch.

steps.sk: Kaša je hotová, keď sa zo zrniek oddelia malé biele krúžky (klíčky) a tekutina je takmer vpitá. Primiešaj med a zvyšné mlieko, aby bola krémová, a nechaj ju 3 minúty postáť pod pokrievkou.
steps.en: The porridge is ready when the little white rings (the germ) come away from the seeds and the liquid is almost absorbed. Stir in the honey and the remaining milk to make it creamy and let it stand, covered, for 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Mango ošúp, odkroj dužinu od kôstky a nakrájaj ju na kocky asi 1 cm. Ak máš limetku, nastrúhaj jej kôru na kašu a ovocie pokvapkaj trochou šťavy – kyslosť zvýrazní sladkosť manga.
steps.en: Peel the mango, cut the flesh away from the stone and dice it into roughly 1 cm cubes. If you have a lime, grate its zest over the porridge and squeeze a little juice over the fruit; the sharpness lifts the mango's sweetness.

steps.sk: Kašu rozdeľ do misiek, navrch daj mango a posyp ju nasucho opraženým kokosom. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni; zohrej ju s trochou mlieka a mango pridaj čerstvé.
steps.en: Divide the porridge between bowls, top with the mango and scatter with dry-toasted coconut. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days; reheat it with a little milk and add the mango fresh.

title.sk: Cesnakové hrianky s volským okom
title.en: Garlic fried bread with a fried egg

description.sk: Chrumkavé hrianky natreté cesnakom a vajce so žĺtkom – lacná domáca klasika.
description.en: Crisp fried bread rubbed with garlic and a runny egg: a cheap home classic.

steps.sk: Cesnak ošúp a strúčiky rozpoľ. Na hrianky sa najlepšie hodí deň starý chlieb – je suchší, nasaje menej oleja a zvonka sa opečie do chrumkava, kým vnútri zostane mäkký.
steps.en: Peel the garlic and halve the cloves. Day-old bread is best for this: it is drier, soaks up less oil and fries crisp outside while staying soft within.

steps.sk: Na panvici zohrej 2 lyžice oleja na strednom ohni, vlož krajce a opekaj ich 2 až 3 minúty z každej strany, kým nie sú zlatohnedé a chrumkavé. Ak olej vpijú, pridaj trochu, ale nie veľa – hrianky nemajú byť mastné.
steps.en: Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat, add the slices and fry them for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden brown and crisp. If they soak up the oil, add a little more, but not much; the bread should not be greasy.

steps.sk: Horúce hrianky hneď potri z jednej strany prekrojeným cesnakom – drsný povrch ho akoby postrúha a cesnak pustí aromatickú šťavu. Jemne ich posoľ a prelož na tanier.
steps.en: Straight away, rub one side of each hot slice with the cut garlic; the rough surface almost grates it and the garlic releases its fragrant juice. Salt them lightly and transfer to a plate.

steps.sk: Do tej istej panvice pridaj zvyšný olej, rozbi vajcia a na miernom ohni ich opekaj 3 minúty, kým bielok nestuhne a žĺtok zostane tekutý. Okraje bielka môžu byť chrumkavé – presne tak to má byť.
steps.en: Add the rest of the oil to the same pan, crack in the eggs and fry them over a low heat for 3 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still runny. The edges of the whites may crisp up, and that is just right.

steps.sk: Na každý tanier polož dve hrianky, na jednu z nich vajce, okoreň ho a posyp pažítkou. Podávaj s kyslou uhorkou, ktorá osvieži mastnú chuť; hodí sa na raňajky aj na rýchlu večeru.
steps.en: Put two slices on each plate with an egg on one of them, season with pepper and sprinkle with chives. Serve with a pickle to freshen the richness; it suits breakfast as well as a quick supper.

title.sk: Zelené smoothie so špenátom, banánom a kefírom
title.en: Green smoothie with spinach, banana and kefir

description.sk: Svieže smoothie, v ktorom je špenát cítiť len farbou.
description.en: A fresh smoothie where you notice the spinach only by its colour.

steps.sk: Špenát dôkladne umy a nechaj odkvapkať; ak má listy s hrubými stopkami, stopky odtrhni. Banán ošúp a nalámaj na kúsky, jablko zbav jadrovníka a nakrájaj ho na kocky aj so šupkou.
steps.en: Wash the spinach well and let it drain; if the leaves have thick stalks, tear them off. Peel the banana and break it into pieces, core the apple and dice it with its skin.

steps.sk: Do mixéra najprv nalej kefír, pridaj špenát a mixuj 30 sekúnd, kým nie je zmes úplne hladká – listy sa tak rozmixujú bez kúskov. Až potom pridaj banán, jablko, ovsené vločky, citrónovú šťavu a zázvor.
steps.en: Pour the kefir into the blender first, add the spinach and blend for 30 seconds until completely smooth, so the leaves break down without bits. Only then add the banana, apple, oats, lemon juice and ginger.

steps.sk: Mixuj ešte minútu na najvyšších otáčkach, kým smoothie nie je krémové a jednoliate. Ochutnaj ho; ak je banán málo zrelý, pridaj lyžičku medu, a ak je príliš husté, prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: Blend for another minute on the highest speed until creamy and uniform. Taste it; if the banana was not very ripe, add a teaspoon of honey, and if it is too thick, add a little water.

steps.sk: Nalej ho do pohára a vypi hneď – svieža farba aj chuť sa postátím strácajú a smoothie sa rozvrství. Ak ho berieš so sebou, pred pitím ním poriadne zatras.
steps.en: Pour it into a glass and drink it straight away; the bright colour and taste fade on standing and it separates. If you take it with you, give it a good shake before drinking.

title.sk: Rösti so slaninou a volským okom
title.en: Rösti with bacon and a fried egg

description.sk: Švajčiarska chrumkavá placka zo strúhaných zemiakov, slanina a vajce.
description.en: A crisp Swiss cake of grated potato with bacon and a fried egg.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a nastrúhaj nahrubo, cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno. Zemiaky zabaľ do čistej utierky a nad umývadlom ich silno vyžmýkaj – čím viac vody dostaneš von, tým bude rösti chrumkavejšie.
steps.en: Peel and coarsely grate the potatoes and finely chop the onion. Wrap the potatoes in a clean tea towel and wring them out hard over the sink; the more water you squeeze out, the crisper the rösti.

steps.sk: Slaninu nakrájaj na drobné kocky a na nepriľnavej panvici (asi 24 cm) ju opekaj na strednom ohni 4 minúty, kým nepustí tuk a nie je chrumkavá. Vyber ju lyžicou, tuk nechaj v panvici.
steps.en: Cut the bacon into small dice and fry it in a non-stick pan (about 24 cm) over a medium heat for 4 minutes until it renders its fat and turns crisp. Lift it out with a spoon, leaving the fat in the pan.

steps.sk: Zemiaky zmiešaj s cibuľou, slaninou, soľou a korením. Do panvice s tukom pridaj maslo, zemiakovú zmes rozprestri na celé dno a stierkou ju pritlač na rovnú placku hrubú asi 1,5 cm.
steps.en: Mix the potatoes with the onion, bacon, salt and pepper. Add the butter to the fat in the pan, spread the potato mixture over the whole base and press it down with a spatula into an even cake about 1.5 cm thick.

steps.sk: Opekaj na miernom až strednom ohni 10 až 12 minút bez miešania, kým spodok nie je hlboko zlatohnedý. Netrp netrpezlivosťou – ak placku obrátiš skôr, ako sa spodok spečie, rozpadne sa.
steps.en: Fry over a low to medium heat for 10 to 12 minutes without stirring until the underside is deep golden brown. Do not rush it: turn the cake before the base has set and it falls apart.

steps.sk: Prikry panvicu veľkým tanierom, rýchlo ju prevráť a placku vsuň späť do panvice opečenou stranou nahor; ak treba, pridaj kúsok masla. Opekaj ďalších 10 minút, kým nie je chrumkavá aj druhá strana a zemiaky vnútri mäkké.
steps.en: Cover the pan with a large plate, flip it over quickly and slide the cake back into the pan, browned side up, adding a knob of butter if needed. Fry for 10 minutes more until the second side is crisp too and the potato inside is tender.

steps.sk: Medzitým na malej panvici s olejom opeč dve volské oká, kým bielok nestuhne a žĺtok zostane tekutý. Rösti rozkroj na polovice, na každú polož vajce a posyp pažítkou; podávaj hneď, kým je chrumkavé.
steps.en: Meanwhile fry two eggs in the oil in a small pan until the whites are set and the yolks still runny. Cut the rösti in half, top each half with an egg and sprinkle with chives; serve at once while it is crisp.

title.sk: Gyeran-jjim – kórejský parený vaječný krém
title.en: Gyeran-jjim: Korean steamed egg

description.sk: Nadýchané vajcia parené vo vývare, jemné ako puding; podávajú sa k ryži.
description.en: Fluffy eggs steamed in broth, soft as a custard and served with rice.

steps.sk: Polovicu bujónu rozpusti v 250 ml horúcej vody a nechaj vychladnúť na vlažnú teplotu. Vajcia rozšľahaj v miske, prilej k nim vývar a premiešaj; zmes preceď cez sitko, aby bol krém hladký a bez bubliniek.
steps.en: Dissolve the half stock cube in 250 ml of hot water and let it cool until lukewarm. Beat the eggs in a bowl, pour in the stock and stir, then strain the mixture through a sieve so the custard is smooth and free of bubbles.

steps.sk: Jarnú cibuľku nakrájaj nadrobno a polovicu primiešaj do vajec. Zmes nalej do malého hrnca s hrubým dnom alebo do kameninovej misky s pokrievkou; zaplniť ju má asi do dvoch tretín, lebo vajce nakyprie.
steps.en: Finely chop the spring onion and stir half of it into the eggs. Pour the mixture into a small heavy-based pan or a lidded earthenware bowl, filling it about two-thirds full, as the egg puffs up.

steps.sk: Hrniec postav na stredný oheň a za stáleho miešania od dna zohrievaj 2 minúty, kým okraje nezačnú tuhnúť. Potom ho prikry, zníž oheň na najmenší a nechaj 8 až 10 minút pariť, kým vajce nie je nadýchané a v strede pevné.
steps.en: Set the pan over a medium heat and warm it for 2 minutes, stirring from the bottom, until the edges start to set. Then cover, turn the heat to the lowest setting and let it steam for 8 to 10 minutes until the egg is fluffy and set in the middle.

steps.sk: Ak nemáš hrniec s ťažkou pokrievkou, misku postav do väčšieho hrnca s 3 cm vriacej vody a par ju 12 minút pod pokrievkou. Krém je hotový, keď sa pri zatrasení chveje ako puding a špajdľa z neho vyjde čistá.
steps.en: If you have no pan with a heavy lid, stand the bowl in a larger pan with 3 cm of boiling water and steam it, covered, for 12 minutes. The custard is done when it wobbles like a pudding and a skewer comes out clean.

steps.sk: Pokvapkaj ho sezamovým olejom, posyp zvyšnou cibuľkou a sezamom a podávaj hneď v nádobe, kým je horúci. Patrí k nemu miska ryže; naberá sa lyžicou spolu s ňou.
steps.en: Drizzle with the sesame oil, sprinkle with the rest of the spring onion and the sesame seeds and serve at once in its dish while piping hot. It belongs with a bowl of rice and is eaten by the spoonful alongside it.

title.sk: Harcha – marocké krupicové placky s medom
title.en: Harcha: Moroccan semolina flatbreads with honey

description.sk: Maslové placky z krupice pečené na panvici, drobivé ako koláč.
description.en: Buttery semolina flatbreads cooked in a pan, crumbly like a cake.

steps.sk: V miske zmiešaj krupicu, cukor, prášok do pečiva a soľ. Prilej rozpustené vlažné maslo a prstami ho vtieraj do krupice, kým nepripomína vlhký piesok – každé zrnko má byť obalené tukom.
steps.en: Mix the semolina, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl. Pour in the melted, lukewarm butter and rub it into the semolina with your fingers until it looks like damp sand; every grain should be coated in fat.

steps.sk: Postupne prilievaj mlieko a vareškou miešaj, kým nevznikne mäkké, vlhké cesto, ktoré drží pokope. Nechaj ho 10 minút odpočinúť; krupica nasaje tekutinu a cesto stuhne natoľko, že sa bude dať tvarovať.
steps.en: Gradually pour in the milk, stirring with a wooden spoon, until you have a soft, damp dough that holds together. Let it rest for 10 minutes; the semolina soaks up the liquid and the dough firms enough to shape.

steps.sk: Mokrými rukami z neho vytvaruj 8 guliek a každú medzi dlaňami sploští na placku s priemerom asi 8 cm a hrúbkou 1 cm. Okraje môžu popraskať, to je v poriadku – harcha má byť rustikálna.
steps.en: With wet hands, shape it into 8 balls and flatten each between your palms into a round about 8 cm across and 1 cm thick. The edges may crack, which is fine; harcha is meant to look rustic.

steps.sk: Suchú nepriľnavú panvicu zohrej na miernom ohni a peč placky 5 minút z jednej strany, kým nie sú zlatohnedé, potom ich obráť a peč ďalších 5 minút. Na príliš silnom ohni zhnednú skôr, ako sa vnútri prepečú.
steps.en: Heat a dry non-stick pan over a low heat and cook the flatbreads for 5 minutes on one side until golden brown, then turn and cook for 5 minutes more. Over too high a heat they brown before the inside is cooked.

steps.sk: Podávaj ich teplé, rozkrojené a pokvapkané medom, alebo s maslom a džemom. Sú drobivé ako koláč a navrchu chrumkavé; vychladnuté opeč nasucho na panvici a znova zmäknú.
steps.en: Serve them warm, split and drizzled with honey, or with butter and jam. They are crumbly like cake with a crisp crust; reheat cold ones in a dry pan and they soften again.

title.sk: Vajcia en cocotte so smotanou a pažítkou
title.en: Eggs en cocotte with cream and chives

description.sk: Vajcia zapečené v miskách so smotanou a šunkou, do ktorých sa namáča toast.
description.en: Eggs baked in little dishes with cream and ham, for dipping toast into.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C a priprav zapekaciu misu, do ktorej sa zmestia 4 malé zapekacie misky. Misky vymasti maslom; do veľkej misy neskôr nalej horúcu vodu, ktorá vajcia ochráni pred prudkým teplom.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and find a baking dish that holds 4 small ramekins. Butter the ramekins; later you will pour hot water into the dish to shield the eggs from fierce heat.

steps.sk: Šunku nakrájaj na drobné prúžky a rozdeľ ju na dno misiek. Do každej nalej lyžicu smotany a opatrne do nej rozbi jedno vajce tak, aby sa žĺtok neporušil; navrch daj ešte lyžicu smotany a posyp parmezánom.
steps.en: Cut the ham into thin strips and divide it between the ramekins. Spoon a tablespoon of cream into each and carefully crack in an egg without breaking the yolk; top with another spoonful of cream and a sprinkling of parmesan.

steps.sk: Misky postav do zapekacej misy a nalej do nej toľko horúcej vody z kanvice, aby siahala do polovice ich výšky. Opatrne ju vlož do rúry a peč 12 až 14 minút.
steps.en: Stand the ramekins in the baking dish and pour in enough hot water from the kettle to come halfway up their sides. Carefully put it in the oven and bake for 12 to 14 minutes.

steps.sk: Vajcia sú hotové, keď je bielok biely a stuhnutý, ale žĺtok sa pri zatrasení ešte chveje. V horúcej smotane sa dopekajú ďalej, preto ich radšej vyber o minútu skôr ako neskôr. Medzitým opeč toast a nakrájaj ho na prúžky.
steps.en: The eggs are done when the whites are white and set but the yolks still tremble when shaken. They keep cooking in the hot cream, so take them out a minute early rather than late. Toast the bread meanwhile and cut it into fingers.

steps.sk: Vytiahni misky z vody, vajcia osoľ, okoreň a posyp pažítkou. Podávaj hneď s prúžkami toastu, ktoré namáčaš do žĺtka so smotanou.
steps.en: Lift the ramekins out of the water, season the eggs with salt and pepper and sprinkle with chives. Serve at once with the toast fingers for dipping into the yolk and cream.

title.sk: Bircher müsli s jablkom a kefírom
title.en: Bircher muesli with apple and kefir

description.sk: Švajčiarske namočené vločky so strúhaným jablkom a orieškami.
description.en: Swiss soaked oats with grated apple and hazelnuts.

steps.sk: Večer zmiešaj v miske ovsené vločky s kefírom, medom, škoricou a hrozienkami. Misku prikry a daj na noc do chladničky – vločky za 8 hodín zmäknú a kefír ich jemne prekvasí, takže budú krémové.
steps.en: In the evening, mix the oats with the kefir, honey, cinnamon and raisins in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight; in 8 hours the oats soften and the kefir lightly cultures them, so they turn creamy.

steps.sk: Ráno nastrúhaj jablko aj so šupkou nahrubo priamo do misky a hneď ho premiešaj s citrónovou šťavou, aby nezhnedlo. Čerstvo nastrúhané jablko je pre Bircher müsli typické – dodá šťavnatosť aj sladkosť.
steps.en: In the morning, coarsely grate the apple, skin and all, straight into a bowl and toss it with the lemon juice at once so it does not brown. Freshly grated apple is what makes Bircher muesli; it adds juiciness and sweetness.

steps.sk: Jablko vmiešaj do namočených vločiek; ak je zmes príliš hustá, rozrieď ju lyžicou mlieka alebo kefíru. Lieskové oriešky opraž 3 minúty na suchej panvici, kým nezavoňajú, a nahrubo ich nasekaj.
steps.en: Stir the apple into the soaked oats; if the mixture is too thick, loosen it with a spoonful of milk or kefir. Toast the hazelnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes until fragrant, then chop them roughly.

steps.sk: Müsli rozdeľ do misiek a posyp ho orieškami. Bez jablka vydrží v chladničke 2 dni, takže si môžeš namočiť dávku na dve rána naraz a jablko strúhať vždy čerstvé.
steps.en: Divide the muesli between bowls and scatter with the hazelnuts. Without the apple it keeps for 2 days in the fridge, so you can soak two mornings' worth at once and grate the apple fresh each time.

title.sk: Batátový hash s paprikou a vajcami
title.en: Sweet potato hash with peppers and eggs

description.sk: Opečené kocky batátov s paprikou a údenou paprikou, navrchu vajcia.
description.en: Pan-fried sweet potato cubes with peppers and smoked paprika, topped with eggs.

steps.sk: Batát ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky asi 1,5 cm – rovnako veľké kocky sa upečú rovnomerne. Papriku zbav semienok a nakrájaj na kúsky, cibuľu na hrubšie mesiačiky.
steps.en: Peel the sweet potato and cut it into roughly 1.5 cm cubes; even cubes cook evenly. Seed the pepper and cut it into pieces, and cut the onion into thick wedges.

steps.sk: Vo veľkej panvici s pokrievkou zohrej olej na strednom ohni, pridaj batát, osoľ ho polovicou soli a opekaj 5 minút, kým sa kocky zo strán nezačnú farbiť. Potom prilej 3 lyžice vody, prikry a nechaj 6 minút dusiť, kým batát nezmäkne.
steps.en: Heat the oil over a medium heat in a large pan with a lid, add the sweet potato, season with half the salt and fry for 5 minutes until the cubes start to colour. Then add 3 tablespoons of water, cover and let it steam for 6 minutes until tender.

steps.sk: Odkry panvicu, pridaj papriku, cibuľu, údenú papriku, rascu (kmín) a zvyšnú soľ a opekaj ďalších 6 až 8 minút bez častého miešania. Kocky potrebujú kontakt s dnom panvice, aby sa vytvorila chrumkavá kôrka.
steps.en: Uncover, add the pepper, onion, smoked paprika, cumin and the remaining salt and fry for 6 to 8 minutes more without stirring too often. The cubes need contact with the base of the pan to form a crisp crust.

steps.sk: Ak používaš špenát, vmiešaj ho a nechaj zvädnúť. Lyžicou urob v zelenine 4 jamky, do každej rozbi vajce a panvicu prikry; var na miernom ohni 5 až 6 minút, kým bielky nestuhnú a žĺtky zostanú mäkké.
steps.en: If using spinach, stir it in and let it wilt. Make 4 hollows in the vegetables with a spoon, crack an egg into each and cover the pan; cook over a low heat for 5 to 6 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still soft.

steps.sk: Okoreň a podávaj priamo z panvice, podľa chuti s plátkami avokáda. Hash bez vajec vydrží v chladničke 3 dni – ráno ho zohrej na panvici a vajcia pridaj čerstvé.
steps.en: Season with pepper and serve straight from the pan, with sliced avocado if you like. Without the eggs, the hash keeps in the fridge for 3 days; reheat it in a pan and add fresh eggs.
